title: Surfacing and Applying Meaning: Supporting Hermeneutical Autonomy for LGBTQ+ People in Taiwan
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally centered on the philosophical and ethical concepts of hermeneutical and epistemic injustice/autonomy. It designs and evaluates an LLM-powered system specifically to address these interpretive and knowledge-related ethical needs, navigating traditional societal values (including Confucianism).
